parameters.name: ruleId
parameters.description: Specifies the rule ID. This value can be obtained using the GET /trafficCaptureRules request.

id.description: A unique identifier of the rule

order.description: The rule's order of execution with respect to other Traffic Capture policy rules

rank.description: Admin rank assigned to the rule

locations.description: Name-ID pairs of locations to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule applies to all locations.

locationGroups.description: Name-ID pairs of location groups to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule applies to all location groups.

departments.description: Name-ID pairs of departments to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule applies to all departments.

groups.description: Name-ID pairs of groups to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule applies to all groups.

users.description: Name-ID pairs of users to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule applies to all users.

timeWindows.description: Time intervals during which the rule applies. By default, this field is set to Always, making the rule applicable at all times.

action.description: The action to be enforced when the traffic matches the rule criteria

state.description: Indicates the rule status as enabled or disabled

lastModifiedTime.description: Timestamp of when the rule was last modified (using POST or PUT request)

lastModifiedBy.description: The admin user who last modified the rule (using POST or PUT request)

srcIps.description: Source IP addresses (IPv4) to which the rule applies. Each entry can be an individual IP address (e.g., 192.0.2.1), a subnet or CIDR (e.g., 192.0.2.0/24), or an address range (e.g., 192.0.2.1 - 192.0.2.5). If no specific value is set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address.

srcIpGroups.description:
Name-ID pairs of source IP groups to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule is not restricted to specific source IP groups.

Note: For organizations that have enabled IPv6, srcIpv6Groups can be used to specify the source IPv6 address groups to which the rule applies.

srcIpv6Groups.description:
Name-ID pairs of source IPv6 groups to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule is not restricted to specific source IPv6 groups.

Note: User-defined groups for IPv6 addresses are currently not supported.

destAddresses.description: Destination IP addresses (IPv4) or FQDNs to which the rule applies. Each IP entry can be an individual IP address (e.g., 192.0.2.1), a subnet or CIDR (e.g., 192.0.2.0/24), or an address range (e.g., 192.0.2.1 - 192.0.2.5). If no specific value is set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address or FQDN.

destCountries.description: Destination countries to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule applies to all destination countries.

sourceCountries.description: The countries of traffic origin that are included or excluded from the rule based on the excludeSrcCountries field value. If no specific value is set, this field is ignored during policy evaluation and the rule is applied to all source countries.

excludeSrcCountries.description: Indicates whether the countries specified in the sourceCountries field are included or excluded from the rule. A true value denotes that the specified source countries are excluded from the rule. A false value denotes that the rule is applied to the source countries if there is a match.

destIpGroups.description:
Name-ID pairs of destination IP groups to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule is not restricted to specific destination IP groups.

Note: For organizations that have enabled IPv6, destIpv6Groups can be used to specify the destination IPv6 address groups to which the rule applies.

destIpv6Groups.description:
Name-ID pairs of destination IPv6 groups to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule is not restricted to specific destination IPv6 groups.

Note: User-defined groups for IPv6 addresses are currently not supported.

nwServices.description: Name-ID pairs of network services to which the rule applies

nwServiceGroups.description: Name-ID pairs of network service groups to which the rule applies

nwApplications.description: Network applications to which the rule applies

nwApplicationGroups.description: Network application groups to which the rule applies

appServiceGroups.description: Application service groups to which the rule applies

devices.description: Name-ID pairs of devices to which the rule applies

deviceGroups.description: Name-ID pairs of device groups to which the rule applies

deviceTrustLevels.description: Device trust levels to which the rule applies. If no specific value is set, the rule applies to all device trust levels.

txnSizeLimit.description: The maximum size of traffic to capture per connection

txnSampling.description: The percentage of connections sampled for capturing each time the rule is triggered

predefined.description: A Boolean field that indicates whether this is a predefined rule by using the true value

defaultRule.description: A Boolean field that indicates whether this is a default rule by using the true value

TrafficCaptureRule.description: Traffic Capture policy rule details. To learn more about the individual rule fields, see Configuring the Traffic Capture Policy.

TrafficCaptureRuleOrderInfo.description: Rule order information for the Traffic Capture policy rules

ruleOrderRange.description: Admin rank mapping with the rule order (represented in a range)

maxOrderConfigured.description: The maximum rule order assigned to the Traffic Capture policy rules

id.description: A unique identifier for an entity

name.description: The configured name of the entity

externalId.description: An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

EntityReference.description: This is an immutable reference to an entity that mainly consists of id and name
